newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: EU welcomes December elections in Ghana.
newsitem.headline: EU welcomes December elections in Ghana.

text.p: The European Union welcomed presidential and parliamentary elections due to take place in Ghana on December 7 and said it would provide a number of observers to monitor them.
A statement issued late on Tuesday on behalf of the 15-nation bloc by Ireland, current EU president, said the elections were "an important further step forward in Ghana's democratic development".
The EU said it "looks forward to the conduct of these elections in a free and fair manner, the results of which should thus be respected by all parties involved".

Ghana's President Jerry Rawlings was a flight-lieutenant who seized power, handed it back to civilians and then seized power once again, staying on to win elections. He is seeking a final four-year term of office in the elections.
